problems.problem: Inbound leads generated through Google Ads outside standard weekday hours (evenings and weekends) may experience delayed response times.
problems.label: hypothesis
problems.basis: The business lists active operating hours strictly between 8:00 AM and 4:30 PM Monday through Friday and provides only a phone number and basic web form, without visible 24/7 automated instant response or live scheduling.

problems.problem: Estimate requests submitted via web forms require manual review, logging, and follow-up, creating the possibility of leads slipping through during peak trade seasons.
problems.label: hypothesis
problems.basis: The website shows no connection to a dedicated field-service CRM or automated booking engine; all inquiries prompt manual written estimates.

existingSolutions.solution: Field Service Management platform (e.g., Jobber, Housecall Pro, or ServiceTitan) with built-in instant online booking and automatic SMS/email lead replies.
existingSolutions.addresses: Captures customer details immediately, books estimate slots, and prevents manual data entry.

existingSolutions.solution: After-hours answering service or automated VoIP missed-call auto-texting system.
existingSolutions.addresses: Provides immediate engagement when prospects call during evening or weekend hours.

forgexSolutions.name: Revenue Leak Check
forgexSolutions.description: In one week, see how many calls, leads and quotes slip through, and what they are worth to you. The $500 fee is credited in full to any fix you order within 30 days.
forgexSolutions.problem: Uncertainty regarding whether Google Ads spend is losing prospects who call or submit forms outside 8:00 AM–4:30 PM hours.
forgexSolutions.whyNotExistingSoftware: Provides an immediate diagnostic assessment of real lead loss without committing to or configuring new enterprise software suites.

forgexSolutions.name: Lead-to-job pipeline
forgexSolutions.description: Every lead from every source lands in your field-service software within two minutes, gets an instant reply, and nobody forgets to call back.
forgexSolutions.problem: Web form submissions and ad leads do not receive automated immediate confirmations or fast routing to staff.
forgexSolutions.whyNotExistingSoftware: Standard Squarespace web forms do not offer native two-way SMS auto-replies or automated dispatch integration without custom integration layers.

feasibility.explanation: Squarespace web form submission hooks and Google Ads conversion events can be cleanly integrated with automated notification webhooks and dispatch tools without altering existing core web design.

aiDelivery.explanation: AI agents can parse customer inquiry details, send immediate scheduling confirmations, and draft preliminary triage summaries, but all technical electrical assessments and code-compliant written estimates require a licensed journeyman or master electrician.

humanReview: Verification and approval of all technical electrical quotes and formal written estimates by a licensed journeyman or master electrician.
Approval of scheduled field service appointments prior to technician dispatch.

risks.description: Automated messages must not over-promise technician availability or issue preliminary pricing without on-site technical inspection.
All electrical work recommendations must adhere strictly to Idaho state electrical codes and master contractor licensing regulations (#CE061542 / #ME059080).
Homeowner and commercial client contact information, access notes, and service addresses submitted via web forms must be transmitted and stored securely.

assumptions: Crofts Electric publishes promotional percentage discounts (e.g., 15% labor discount for new clients, 10% for repeat clients) but does not list fixed dollar prices or hourly labor rates on its public website, preventing a mathematically supportable value calculation under ForgeX rules.

discovery.outreachSubject: Handling after-hours electrical inquiries from Crofts Electric's Google Ads
discovery.outreachBody:
Hi [redacted],

I noticed Crofts Electric is running search advertising for electrical service calls in Boise while operating weekday hours from 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM.

When homeowners or commercial property managers request an estimate in the evening or over the weekend, does your system send an instant automated reply to keep them engaged, or do those requests wait until the team opens the following morning?

At ForgeX, we help trade contractors ensure every inbound ad and web lead gets an immediate acknowledgment and gets tracked into your dispatch queue within two minutes, without adding admin burden to your technicians.

If you'd be open to a brief conversation about how other electrical contractors handle after-hours lead capture, please let me know.

Best regards,

[Founder Name]
Founder, ForgeX
[Founder Phone]
[Founder Email]
[ForgeX Postal Address]

If you prefer not to receive future emails regarding this, reply with 'unsubscribe' and we will remove your contact details immediately.

limitations: The exact number of field technicians or office staff employed in the Boise location is not stated on the website, making it impossible to verify whether the business meets ForgeX's 10 to 75 staff threshold.
No specific dollar pricing is published on the site, precluding supportable commercial ROI calculations.
No direct business email address is published on the site; only a telephone number and a web contact form are provided.

qualification.rationale: Crofts Electric is an owner-led electrical contractor operating in Boise, Idaho, and shows evidence of paid lead generation via active Google Ads tracking. However, its exact staff size cannot be verified from the website alone (the business presents as a family-owned operation expanding from Kentucky to Boise, but whether it employs 10 to 75 staff is unconfirmed). In addition, operational challenges regarding lead loss or response lag are plausible hypotheses rather than publicly verifiable broken workflows. Pursuing later allows confirmation of staff size and intake volume before initiating an active sales motion.
